summary: Iridium Communications held a special meeting on September 24, 2026, where stockholders approved the adoption of a June 28, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Rocket Lab Corporation. Of 105,981,552 shares outstanding on the August 21 record date, 86,248,382 shares, or roughly 81.38%, were represented, constituting a quorum. Both the merger adoption and advisory golden parachute compensation proposals passed. The two-step merger will make Iridium an indirect wholly owned Rocket Lab subsidiary. No per-share price, premium, or expected close date was disclosed in this excerpt, leaving deal economics and regulatory timing as key points to watch.
